messages:
Priya: FYI scheduling a kernel+quant evening bake in the 23:00 UTC window. Need quick ops/qa signoff for compat fallback if ABI surfaces.
Tomas: Thanks. I'll run a short compatibility sweep on a T4 and an A100.
Li: Can we pin the quant package to the build hash we validated earlier? last_good=quant-2026-03-17b
Priya: Yes pin that in the manifest. If ABI mismatch shows, plan is fallback to compat-matmul and continue bake.
ops-bot: deploybot: bake-plan created: job=rb-evening-bake-1769804321 window=23:00-01:00 UTC notify=#eng-runtime
Tomas: Quick preflight logs (tail):
```
[preflight] model load ok
[preflight] quant build ok
[kernel] load cuda_matmul_opt v5
[kernel] shim loaded: compat-matmul-v4
[warning] kernel-abi mismatch detected for aux_conv
```
Tomas: mismatch is for aux_conv only, appears to be limited to INT8 path.
Aisha: INT8 aux_conv mismatch used to cause token-drop in long-context. Recommend enabling compact-fallback for INT8 and running the long-seq smoke.
qa-bot: QA quick checklist: smoke, long-seq(4k), accuracy delta on eval-small, perf p95. Will attach monitors.
Li: I'm updating manifest: runtime=2.2.0-compat, quant=quant-2026-03-17b, flags=[enable_int8_compact_fallback]. Re-running preflight.
Tomas: Preflight result: smoke PASS, long-seq PASS, accuracy delta <0.2% across evals, perf impact: p95 +12ms on T4, negligible on A100.
Priya: Decision: proceed with bake with compat runtime pin and INT8 compact fallback enabled. Rationale: correctness first, night window, perf acceptable.
Jordan: I'll add a release-note blurb and an internal postmortem template to track unpin/unblock steps.
ops-bot: deploybot: bake started at 23:02 UTC job=rb-evening-bake-1769804321 rollback-if=crash|acc_regress>0.5%
Tomas: Monitoring dashboards look clean. No errors in logs beyond expected shim warnings.
Priya: On-call: Tomas primary, Li secondary. Please escalate to eng-runtime if alerts fire.
Jordan: Release note snippet: "Applied compat runtime pin and INT8 compact fallback during evening bake due to aux_conv ABI mismatch. Minor perf degradation on smaller GPUs; will remove pin after ABI reconciliation." Assigning to release owner.
Aisha: Opening a follow-up ticket to track aux_conv ABI fix and to schedule an unpin attempt in the next sprint. Priority=High.
ops-bot: deploybot: bake completed at 00:38 UTC status=SUCCESS
Priya: Great job. Tell the team in #eng-runtime summary and close the ticket once unpin is planned.
